{{Quote|When we recovered the jewels from Domina years ago, we sent them out here to the Unknown Regions on that Star Destroyer where nobody would come looking.|Leia Organa|<ref name="SW108" />}}
This '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|They sure don't make them like this anymore.|[[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]]|<ref name="SW108" />}}
[[File:SD_Crimson_Forever_Bridge.jpg|thumb|left|215px|The Star Destroyer's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]]]
This [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was 1,600 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, the standard length for an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" /> However, it featured a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] with a different interior design than the standard ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] also housed several [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratories]].<ref name="SW50" />

The Star Destroyer was particularly resilient, as was shown when it was adrift during several [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Despite being near a dying [[Star/Legends|star]] and hit by [[Meteorite/Legends|meteors]], most of the ship still had operational [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|gravity]] and [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems.<ref name="SW108" />

The Star Destroyer carried a complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and at least one [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]].<ref name="SW108" />

==History==
===Near the Red Nebula===
{{Quote|We found an ''Imperial cruiser'' waiting just outside the nebula! ''Darth Vader'' had learned of my journey and dispatched a warship to discover the ''secret'' behind it.|[[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]]|<ref name="SW50" />}}
[[File:SD_Crimson_Forever_Red_Nebula.jpg|thumb|right|240px|The Star Destroyer fighting [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge's]] [[Mining Explorer]] near the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]]]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], this ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer was sent to the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to discover why [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] was traveling to this remote [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], located outside the main body of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Tagge, along with a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], was actually searching for the [[Great Life Jewels]], two [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] that could create a [[Death/Legends|fatal]] [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as the [[Crimson Forever]] when they were separated. Tagge hoped to use the gems' deadly powers in order to destroy both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SW50" />

When the Star Destroyer encountered Tagge's [[Mining Explorer]] on its way back from the Red Nebula, it [[Mission to the Red Nebula|destroyed]] the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter's]] drive [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] boarded the vessel and forced Tagge to surrender her find. The Imperial boarding party received only one of the two gems, placed by Tagge in a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] cannister rigged to open under the pressures of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Tagge also gave the Imperials the location of the new Rebel [[Golrath Station|base]] on [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]], which she had learned from her [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. Tagge then orchestrated a [[Lightfight|firefight]] between her bounty hunters and the stormtroopers, which forced the boarders to leave the Mining Explorer, effectively separating the two Great Life Jewels.<ref name="SW50" />

===In the Golrath system===
{{Quote|It's ''incredible'', Commander Skywalker! Their scanners must've picked us up ''long'' ago, b-but&hellip;''"<br />"''They haven't taken any defensive or evasive action. Not only ''that'', Red Flight Three&mdash;but according to Artoo-Detoo back in the droid slot, he's not getting any ''life form readings'' from in there!|[[Red Flight]] [[Red Three/Legends|Three]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="SW50" />}}
[[File:Golrath_system.jpg|thumb|left|270px|[[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] of [[Red Flight]] approaching the plagued Star Destroyer in the [[Golrath system/Legends|Golrath system]]]]
Following the firefight, the Imperials abandoned the damaged Mining Explorer on the fringes of the Red Nebula. The Star Destroyer set a course for Golrath and jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. As a result, the carbonite cannister holding the gem opened and the Crimson Forever spread aboard the ship. When the Star Destroyer arrived in the [[Golrath system/Legends|Golrath system]], the entire crew had succumbed from the effects of the plague.<ref name="SW50" />

Shortly after its arrival in the Golrath [[Star system/Legends|system]], the Rebels detected the Star Destroyer and sent [[Red Flight]] to intercept it. The group of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]], led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], found no life form readings from inside the Star Destroyer and decided to board the ship to investigate. Aboard the Star Destroyer, the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] found the crimson bodies of the Imperials, most of them still at their stations. They also discovered the red gem in one of the ship's laboratories. The Rebels soon became infected with the Crimson Forever and Skywalker ordered an immediate evacuation of the boarding party. After their return to Golrath Station, all the Rebels that were in contact with the plague perished, except Skywalker whose [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] enabled him to fight it better.<ref name="SW50" />

[[File:SD_Crimson_Forever_Golrath_system.jpg|thumb|right|270px|The Star Destroyer shortly before its programmed jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]]]
Fortunately, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] had previously encountered such red gems during a previous [[Attack on the Red Nebula temple|misadventure]] in the Red Nebula. After hearing the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee's]] tale of the event, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Chewbacca decided to travel to the Red Nebula aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in hopes of finding a cure for the Crimson Forever. On their way to the Red Nebula, they encountered the derelict Mining Explorer. After a [[Skirmish aboard the Mining Explorer|short fight]], they agreed to free Tagge and her companions in order to reunite the two red gems and end the Crimson Forever. The Rebels then left the Great Life Jewels inside the Star Destroyer's bridge and programmed the ship to jump to hyperspace toward the [[Intergalactic Void]].<ref name="SW50" />

===In the Unknown Regions===
{{Quote|The crew had already succumbed to the Crimson Forever when we sent it off. There was nobody alive to bring it back. How could it pull us out of hyperspace now?''"<br />"''It wasn't the destroyer. It's ''that sun''. Seems like we don't have to worry about those stones after all. Sun's gonna go supernova soon and pull the destroyer, the stones and everything else nearby in before it does.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="SW108" />}}
[[File:SD_Crimson_Forever_Unknown_Regions.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The wreckage of the Star Destroyer in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]]]
During its journey however, the Star Destroyer was pulled out of hyperspace in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] because of the [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] generated by a sun about to go [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Adrift, the wreckage was ransacked by [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]] who found the red gems but soon succumbed to the Crimson Forever.<ref name="SW108" />

Several years later, in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Tagge went after the Great Life Jewels a second time in a new attempt to spread the Crimson Forever in the galaxy. This [[Mission to retrieve the Great Life Jewels|mission]] was funded by the [[Tof resistance]], which also sought revenge on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] defeat during the [[Nagai–Tof War]].<ref name="SW108" />

Following a hunch, a New Republic team went after the Star Destroyer in order to stop Tagge's plan. There, they found the red gems but were caught up by Tagge and her [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. To their surprise, the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] also arrived on the scene in hopes of using the gems' powers to restore his damaged body. Eventually, Valance sacrificed himself to reunite the two red gems and save Skywalker. Plunging in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Valance brought the Great Life Jewels together, healing his body in the process, and let himself be pulled by the sun's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].<ref name="SW108" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SD_Crimson_Forever_Starboard_docking_bay.jpg|thumb|right|235px|The Star Destroyer's starboard [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]]]]
This unidentified ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 50|issue 50]] of the [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, published on [[May 19]], [[1981]].<ref name="SW50" /> It later appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 108|issue 108]] of the same comic series, published on [[May 29]], [[2019]].<ref name="SW108" />

In the first chapter of ''Star Wars 50: The Crimson Forever'', the Star Destroyer was drawn with a [[Tractor beam targeting array/Legends|tractor beam targeting array]] on top of its bridge tower, which is a feature of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]. However, in the third chapter of the same issue, the Star Destroyer was instead drawn with a [[Communications tower/Legends|communications tower]] on top of its bridge tower, which is a feature of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]. Therefore, it is unknown whether this ship was an ''Imperial I'' or ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer.<ref name="SW50" />
